# Support Guide for SubTranscribe Studio

Thank you for using **SubTranscribe Studio**! Before opening a new issue, please check the following resources for assistance.

---

## 📖 Documentation & User Guide

- **[README.md](../README.md)**: Overview of features, installation instructions, and hardware requirements.
- **[Help & Support Screen](../README.md#❓-help--support)**: Built-in application guide covering GPU vs CPU acceleration and supported file formats.

---

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### 1. Why am I seeing a Windows SmartScreen warning when installing?
Unsigned Windows executables often trigger a SmartScreen warning on first run. Click **More info → Run anyway** to proceed.

### 2. How do I enable GPU acceleration?
If you have an NVIDIA GPU, ensure your graphics drivers are up to date. The application automatically detects NVIDIA CUDA and AMD/Intel Vulkan support at startup.

### 3. Are my audio or video files uploaded anywhere?
No. All transcription and translation runs 100% locally on your machine using local AI model weights.

---

## 💬 Community Support & Reporting Issues

- **Found a Bug?**: Check [Existing Issues](https://github.com/mdakashhossain1/SubTranscribe-Studio/issues) first. If your bug hasn't been reported, [Open a Bug Report](https://github.com/mdakashhossain1/SubTranscribe-Studio/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Want a New Feature?**: [Submit a Feature Request](https://github.com/mdakashhossain1/SubTranscribe-Studio/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security Vulnerabilities**: Please review our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) before reporting security issues.
